headline: The cat-and-mouse game over 3D-printed guns has begun
summary: Creator of first 3D-printed gun claims bypass for anti-firearm software. Regulators aim to stem the tide of ghost guns. An escalating battle between creators and government is unfolding.

headline: Zillow and Redfin settle FTC antitrust case over their rental listings partnership
summary: FTC settled an antitrust case against Zillow and Redfin. The case alleged a 2025 partnership violated antitrust laws. Zillow reportedly paid Redfin to syndicate listings and avoid competition.

headline: Robotaxis are real now — so is the pushback
summary: Robotaxis are expanding but face increasing opposition. New York's governor withdrew a proposal for driverless taxis after pushback. Commercial driverless service remains illegal in some areas.

headline: The Witcher 4 developers target a 2028 release
summary: CD Projekt Red aims for a 2028 launch for The Witcher 4. The studio has been working on the title for years. This provides a target release window for fans.

headline: 'How Do We Get Them to Really Cry at This Scene' — Avengers: Infinity War Director Reveals How They Changed Spider-Man's Death Scene to Break Fans' Hearts
summary: Avengers: Infinity War director Joe Russo discussed Spider-Man's death scene. They altered the scene during filming to maximize emotional impact. The goal was to make audiences cry.

headline: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Devs Vow to Update Captain Price After Botched Haircut Goes Viral
summary: Activision and Infinity Ward will update Captain Price's hair in CoD: MW4. His initial haircut went viral for being 'botched.' Developers responded to fan feedback.

headline: Canceled Iron Man Game Footage From Just Cause and Mad Max Developer Leaks Online
summary: Footage of Avalanche Studios' canceled Iron Man game has leaked. Avalanche Studios is known for Just Cause and Mad Max. The game was previously unreleased.

headline: France and Saudi Arabia to Build $7 Billion Dragon Ball Z Theme Park Outside Paris
summary: France and Saudi Arabia are collaborating on a Dragon Ball Z theme park. The park will be built near Paris. It is projected to cost $7 billion USD.

headline: Organised crime arrests as police investigate A66 crash that killed two officers
summary: Nine men and three women have been arrested. Police are investigating the A66 crash that killed seven people. The arrests are linked to organised crime.

headline: How the deadly A66 crash unfolded leaving seven dead
summary: Two police officers died in an A66 motorway collision. Their marked car collided with a Volkswagen Passat. The incident occurred at 03:30 BST on Saturday, leaving seven dead.

headline: Burnham vows support for Ukraine despite 'outrageous threats' from Russia
summary: Burnham pledged continued support for Ukraine. This follows 'outrageous threats' from Russia. Moscow warned of consequences over British drones used by Ukraine.

headline: Is UK's Storm Shadow missile a game changer for Ukraine?
summary: Correspondent Joe Inwood analyzed the Storm Shadow missile technology. It explores if the weapon could be a game-changer for Ukraine. The missile may significantly impact the Russia-Ukraine war.
